reviewNotes: Reviewed all 80 speech keys against the 20 entries with methods in data/seafood22-23.json and app.js buildSeafoodQuestions/buildSeafoodQuestion templates. Fish/seafood names use explicit vocabulary readings. Verified cooking terms including てっかどん, づけ, てりやき, さかむし, さいきょうやき, いしかりなべ, すじめ, すみびやき, にざかな, にあなご, かばやき, しらやき, うなどん, うすづくり, てっちり, かんろに, やきがき and かいせんどん. Topic は in 魚介は and quoted ingredient names rendered わ; object を rendered お. No directional へ occurs. Loanwords フライ and バター rendered ふらい and ばたー, retaining long vowels. Punctuation, display labels and lookup keys preserved. No listening or pitch-accent verification.
